fact.title: Two Working Days: Code On Wages And Employee's Final Settlement
fact.claim: Final wages are due within 2 working days of resigning or being removed. The clock starts on the last working day.
fact.law: Code on Wages 2019, section 17(2). In force since 21 Nov 2025.
fact.caveat: Covers wages only. Gratuity has its own 30 days.

script.cover_1: Your last day was Friday. The last salary has not come.
script.payoff: Reports say final wages are due within 2 working days.
script.caption: Final wages have a deadline, and it is shorter than most people expect. Send this to the friend who just resigned.
script.situation: Can HR hold your last salary for a month after you resign?
script.answer: Reports say final wages are due within 2 working days of resigning or removal. Gratuity is separate.
script.reply_me: Please confirm the date my final wages will be paid. I understand it is due within 2 working days.
